description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [200% ATB 1] and [100% Critical] for 25 seconds to all allies with Attach Lightning, grants grants [Zenith Mode], [Zenith Mode: Shelke (Lightning)], [Damage Cap +10000] to the user

description.name: Zenith Mode: Shelke (Lightning)
description.text: Cast speed x1.10 for Support or Celerity abilities, Celerity abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Shelke (Lightning) after using two Support or Celerity abilities (max 2), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Synaptic Net Dive+

description.name: Transparent+
description.text: Transfers the user's Soul Break points to the target (maximum of 500 Soul Break points), grants [Instant Cast 1] to the target

description.name: Rapid Spark+
description.text: Seven single ranged attacks (?/? each) capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ uses

description.name: 200% ATB 1

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
